fieldValues.title: D6. Cite and revisit: decisions that govern later work
fieldValues.thinking_reached: The ideal: later work cites the decision it applies (pr-check's made block), a decision is revisited when its revisit_when fires, and superseded decisions keep a readable history (SP-38). Domains that turn out to overlap merge, and their decisions with them.
fieldValues.tensions: Keep rulings stable, and revise them from each lesson.
fieldValues.unresolved_questions: Which decisions are never cited? Which revisit_when conditions have fired unnoticed?
fieldValues.next_action: Record a re-asked decision (SP-99) or a contradicted one (SP-104) as a decision-stop finding here.
